identitySignals: AIMS College Prep High School (aimsk12.org) is a charter high school in Oakland, CA that states it submitted a charter renewal petition to Oakland Unified School District, matching an OUSD Office of Charter Schools facilities agreement

aimsk12.org Milestones page says the American Indian Model Schools Board voted in 2019 to rename the schools AIMS K-12 College Prep Charter District, AIMS College Prep High School, etc., linking the registered nonprofit to the AIMS brand
ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists American Indian Model Schools, a 501(c)(3) in Oakland, CA, EIN 94-3309981
Located in Oakland, CA, consistent with an OUSD-authorized charter
research.notes: Agenda names only 'AIMS High Charter School' (the high school). The contact details given are for the K-12 charter district's main office; the high school's own line is 510-220-5044 at 746 Grand Ave, Oakland, CA 94610. Link between the registered nonprofit (American Indian Model Schools) and the AIMS K-12 brand rests on the school's own Milestones page.

profile.summary: A nonprofit that operates AIMS K-12 College Prep Charter District, a group of public charter schools in Oakland, California. The schools serve students from kindergarten through 12th grade, including AIMS College Prep High School for grades 9 to 12.

review.notes: aimsk12.org confirms AIMS High School (Oakland) submitted a charter petition to OUSD, and the Milestones page links the American Indian Model Schools board to the AIMS brand; ProPublica confirms the nonprofit and EIN. Contact details are the district office's, as shown on the homepage, and the summary is neutral and supported.
